summary: Recent discussions in the Iceberg community have focused on integration with Spark 4.1, proposed enhancements for large write operations, and the introduction of new features in the Iceberg REST spec. Additionally, updates on upcoming patch releases and version 1.12.0 were shared, alongside discussions on improving data management and usability.
highlights: Iceberg-Spark integration work including Spark 4.1 framework
Proposed auto flush for large writes to address memory issues
Discussion on adding a generic CatalogObjectIdentifier to REST spec
